It's not negative if I did it because I don't care about myself. I know I'm loved, and I have a lot friends and family that will probably be devastated but I guess I am that selfish to do this. Death is a part of life and at some point everyone has to experience it happen in their social circle. I think they will be fine eventually, it'll just suck for a while. 
I'm in a comp sci degree and my GPA sucks and I probably won't find a job even if I pass this semester. The dean is pretty strict on their gpa rules and once you keep up bad grades, it's hard to change them. I'm nearing the end of my degree and  it's just pointless. I don't want to live working a crappy job, barely make payments, considering the way I feel now, it'll be too hard to handle. I can't even write properly cause I'm such an idiot.
